_doc: 80/20 1020: a 1.00 x 2.00 in (25.4 x 50.8 mm) T-slot profile of the 10 series, six open T-slots, clear anodised. Every value is in mm, with the inch figure it came from in its rule. Dimensions and section figures are from 80/20's Product Catalog 24; it is described lying flat, so inertia_x is the smaller second moment (the catalogue's IY). The drawn outline leaves out the rounds where the webs meet the core, the rounded tips of the lips and the small "align-a-grooves" on the faces.
name: profile-1020-8020
